products.title: Linen Midi Dress
products.description: 100% linen midi dress with side pockets and adjustable waist tie. Breathable, relaxed fit. Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not tumble dry.
products.care: Machine wash cold (30°C), gentle cycle, hang dry, iron on medium heat.
products.fit_note: Runs true to size. Between sizes: choose the larger size for a looser fit.

products.title: CloudStep Running Shoes
products.description: Lightweight running shoes with breathable mesh upper and EVA foam sole. Weight 240 g per shoe (EU 40). Suitable for road running and daily wear, not for trail.
products.material: Mesh upper, EVA midsole, rubber outsole
products.care: Hand wash with mild soap. Do not machine wash.
products.fit_note: Runs half a size small. We recommend ordering half a size up, or one size up for wide feet.

products.title: Mulberry Silk Scarf
products.description: Square scarf in 100% mulberry silk (16 momme). Size 90 x 90 cm. Hand-rolled edges. Comes in a gift box.
products.care: Dry clean or hand wash in cold water with silk detergent. Do not wring.

products.title: Non-slip Yoga Mat 6mm
products.description: TPE yoga mat, 183 x 61 cm, 6 mm thick, double-sided non-slip texture, includes carrying strap. Latex-free and PVC-free.
products.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Air dry away from direct sunlight.

products.title: Waterproof Travel Backpack 30L
products.description: 30L backpack with padded laptop sleeve (fits up to 15.6 inch laptops), USB charging port (power bank not included), water-resistant 600D polyester (IPX4, splash resistant, not submersible). Dimensions 48 x 31 x 20 cm. Meets most airline cabin size limits.
products.care: Spot clean with a damp cloth.

policies.returns: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed and with original tags and packaging. Customers in the EU may withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason (EU right of withdrawal). Return shipping is paid by the customer, except for defective or wrong items, in which case we provide a free return label. Silk scarves can only be returned unopened for hygiene reasons. Returns go to our Spain warehouse in Valencia. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the item. To start a return, the customer must provide the order number and order email.
policies.exchanges: Size exchanges are free once per order, subject to stock. Exchanges are processed as a return plus a new order.
policies.shipping: Items from the Spain warehouse: 2-4 business days to Spain, free shipping on orders over 39 EUR, otherwise 3.99 EUR. Items from the China warehouse: 7-15 business days to Spain, 10-20 business days to Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, Argentina). Shipping to Latin America costs 9.90 EUR, import duties may apply and are paid by the customer. Orders ship within 1-2 business days.
policies.payment: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Prices are in EUR and include VAT for EU customers.
